# Application frame

The frame that wraps every page of an application: AppShell with a collapsible Nav in the sidebar, a Breadcrumb,
a search button and an account menu in the header, and the current page in the main area. `Mod+K` (useHotkeys)
opens a CommandPalette that goes to the pages and runs actions; the account menu and the palette switch the color
mode and the density with useTheme. Three small pages are switched in memory, where a router would plug in.

**Level**: Advanced · **Components used**: [AppShell](../components/AppShell.md), [Avatar](../components/Avatar.md), [Breadcrumb](../components/Breadcrumb.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [CommandPalette](../components/CommandPalette.md), [Dropdown](../components/Dropdown.md), [Grid](../components/Grid.md), [Kbd](../components/Kbd.md), [ListItem](../components/ListItem.md), [Nav](../components/Nav.md), [Page](../components/Page.md), [Panel](../components/Panel.md), [Pill](../components/Pill.md), [Segmented](../components/Segmented.md), [SettingRow](../components/SettingRow.md), [Spacer](../components/Spacer.md), [Stack](../components/Stack.md), [Statistic](../components/Statistic.md), [Switch](../components/Switch.md), [useHotkeys](../components/useHotkeys.md), [useMessage](../components/useMessage.md)

```tsx
import { type Ref, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import {
  AppShell,
  Avatar,
  Breadcrumb,
  Button,
  type ColorModePreference,
  CommandPalette,
  type CommandPaletteItem,
  type Density,
  Dropdown,
  type DropdownMenuItem,
  Grid,
  type IconName,
  Kbd,
  ListItem,
  Nav,
  type NavGroup,
  type NavItem,
  Page,
  Panel,
  Pill,
  type PillProps,
  Segmented,
  SettingRow,
  Spacer,
  Stack,
  Statistic,
  Switch,
  useHotkeys,
  useMessage,
  useTheme,
} from 'vellum-ui'

type PageKey = 'overview' | 'projects' | 'settings'

const PAGES: Readonly<Record<PageKey, { readonly title: string; readonly icon: IconName }>> = {
  overview: { title: 'Overview', icon: 'dashboard' },
  projects: { title: 'Projects', icon: 'folder' },
  settings: { title: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' },
}

const USER_NAME = 'Alex Morgan'

const WORKSPACE = 'Northwind Studio'

interface Project {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly owner: string
  readonly status: 'On track' | 'At risk' | 'Done'
  readonly updated: string
}

const PROJECTS: readonly Project[] = [
  { id: 'p1', name: 'Website refresh', owner: 'Sam Lee', status: 'On track', updated: '2 h ago' },
  { id: 'p2', name: 'Mobile onboarding', owner: 'Riley Chen', status: 'At risk', updated: 'Today' },
  { id: 'p3', name: 'Billing settings', owner: 'Jordan Park', status: 'On track', updated: 'Mon' },
  { id: 'p4', name: 'Quarterly report', owner: 'Alex Morgan', status: 'Done', updated: 'Oct 28' },
]

const STATUS_TONE: Readonly<Record<Project['status'], PillProps['tone']>> = {
  'On track': 'success',
  'At risk': 'warning',
  Done: 'neutral',
}

const NAV: readonly (NavItem | NavGroup)[] = [
  {
    type: 'group',
    label: 'Work',
    items: [
      { key: 'overview', label: PAGES.overview.title, icon: PAGES.overview.icon },
      {
        key: 'projects',
        label: PAGES.projects.title,
        icon: PAGES.projects.icon,
        count: PROJECTS.filter((p) => p.status !== 'Done').length,
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    type: 'group',
    label: 'Workspace',
    items: [{ key: 'settings', label: PAGES.settings.title, icon: PAGES.settings.icon }],
  },
]

const COLOR_MODES: readonly {
  readonly value: ColorModePreference
  readonly label: string
  readonly icon: IconName
}[] = [
  { value: 'light', label: 'Light', icon: 'sun' },
  { value: 'dark', label: 'Dark', icon: 'moon' },
  { value: 'system', label: 'System', icon: 'monitor' },
]

interface PageProps {
  /** The title receives the focus after a navigation, so that screen readers announce the new page. */
  readonly titleRef: Ref<HTMLHeadingElement>
}

function OverviewPage({
  titleRef,
  onOpenProjects,
}: PageProps & { readonly onOpenProjects: () => void }) {
  return (
    <Page title="Overview" subtitle={`${WORKSPACE} this month`} titleRef={titleRef}>
      <Grid columns={3}>
        <Panel>
          <Statistic
            label="Active projects"
            value={3}
            delta={{ value: 0.5, period: 'vs last month' }}
          />
        </Panel>
        <Panel>
          <Statistic
            label="Open tasks"
            value={42}
            delta={{ value: -0.12, period: 'vs last month', goodWhen: 'down' }}
          />
        </Panel>
        <Panel>
          <Statistic
            label="Hours logged"
            value={1284}
            suffix="h"
            delta={{ value: 0.08, period: 'vs last month' }}
          />
        </Panel>
      </Grid>
      <Panel title="Recently updated" flush>
        <Stack gap={1} padding={2}>
          {PROJECTS.slice(0, 3).map((p) => (
            <ListItem key={p.id} title={p.name} meta={p.updated} onClick={onOpenProjects} />
          ))}
        </Stack>
      </Panel>
    </Page>
  )
}

function ProjectsPage({ titleRef }: PageProps) {
  const message = useMessage()
  return (
    <Page
      title="Projects"
      subtitle="Everything the workspace is working on"
      titleRef={titleRef}
      actions={
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          icon="plus"
          onClick={() => message.info('Open the form dialog here')}
        >
          New project
        </Button>
      }
    >
      <Panel flush>
        <Stack gap={1} padding={2}>
          {PROJECTS.map((p) => (
            <ListItem
              key={p.id}
              leading={<Avatar name={p.owner} size={32} />}
              title={p.name}
              description={`${p.owner} · ${p.updated}`}
              meta={<Pill tone={STATUS_TONE[p.status]}>{p.status}</Pill>}
              onClick={() => message.info(`Open "${p.name}" here`)}
            />
          ))}
        </Stack>
      </Panel>
    </Page>
  )
}

function SettingsPage({ titleRef }: PageProps) {
  // The same theme state as the account menu: both places stay in sync
  const { colorMode, setColorMode, density, setDensity } = useTheme()
  return (
    <Page
      title="Settings"
      subtitle="Appearance of the application on this device"
      width="narrow"
      titleRef={titleRef}
    >
      <Panel>
        <SettingRow
          title="Color mode"
          description="System follows the setting of your device."
          control={
            <Segmented<ColorModePreference>
              options={COLOR_MODES}
              value={colorMode}
              onChange={setColorMode}
            />
          }
        />
        <SettingRow
          title="Compact density"
          description="Smaller controls and rows, to see more at once."
          control={
            <Switch
              checked={density === 'compact'}
              onChange={(on) => setDensity(on ? 'compact' : 'comfortable')}
            />
          }
        />
      </Panel>
    </Page>
  )
}

export function AppFrame() {
  const message = useMessage()
  const { mode, colorMode, setColorMode, density, setDensity } = useTheme()
  // A real application reads the page from its router and navigates with the router's function instead
  const [page, setPage] = useState<PageKey>('overview')
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false)
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false)

  // After a navigation, move the focus to the title of the new page (not on the first render)
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null)
  const navigatedTo = useRef<PageKey | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (navigatedTo.current === page) titleRef.current?.focus()
  }, [page])
  const go = (key: PageKey) => {
    navigatedTo.current = key
    setPage(key)
  }

  // Mod+K opens and closes the palette, also from inside text fields
  useHotkeys('mod+k', () => setSearchOpen((o) => !o), {
    description: 'Search and jump',
    allowInInputs: true,
  })

  const signOut = () =>
    message.info('Signed out. A real application returns to its sign-in page here.')
  const nextMode = mode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'

  const commands: CommandPaletteItem[] = [
    ...(Object.keys(PAGES) as PageKey[]).map((key) => ({
      id: `page:${key}`,
      title: PAGES[key].title,
      group: 'Pages',
      icon: PAGES[key].icon,
      onSelect: () => go(key),
    })),
    ...PROJECTS.map((p) => ({
      id: `project:${p.id}`,
      title: p.name,
      group: 'Projects',
      icon: 'project' as const,
      keywords: [p.owner],
      onSelect: () => go('projects'),
    })),
    {
      id: 'theme',
      title: `Switch to ${nextMode} mode`,
      group: 'Actions',
      icon: nextMode === 'dark' ? 'moon' : 'sun',
      keywords: ['theme', 'appearance'],
      onSelect: () => setColorMode(nextMode),
    },
    {
      id: 'density',
      title: density === 'compact' ? 'Use comfortable density' : 'Use compact density',
      group: 'Actions',
      icon: 'rows',
      keywords: ['spacing', 'appearance'],
      onSelect: () => setDensity(density === 'compact' ? 'comfortable' : 'compact'),
    },
    {
      id: 'sidebar',
      title: collapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar',
      group: 'Actions',
      icon: 'sidebar',
      onSelect: () => setCollapsed((c) => !c),
    },
    { id: 'sign-out', title: 'Sign out', group: 'Actions', icon: 'logout', onSelect: signOut },
  ]

  const accountItems: DropdownMenuItem[] = [
    { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'settings' },
    { type: 'divider' },
    ...COLOR_MODES.map((m) => ({ key: `mode:${m.value}`, label: m.label, icon: m.icon })),
    { type: 'divider' },
    { key: 'density:comfortable', label: 'Comfortable density', icon: 'list' },
    { key: 'density:compact', label: 'Compact density', icon: 'rows' },
    { type: 'divider' },
    { key: 'sign-out', label: 'Sign out', icon: 'logout', danger: true },
  ]
  const onAccount = ({ key }: { readonly key: string }) => {
    const [kind, value] = key.split(':')
    if (kind === 'mode') setColorMode(value as ColorModePreference)
    else if (kind === 'density') setDensity(value as Density)
    else if (kind === 'settings') go('settings')
    else if (kind === 'sign-out') signOut()
  }

  return (
    // `contained` fills the preview around the recipe; leave it out in an application, to fill the window
    <AppShell
      contained
      collapsed={collapsed}
      onCollapsedChange={setCollapsed}
      header={
        <>
          <AppShell.Toggle />
          <Breadcrumb
            items={[
              { title: WORKSPACE, onClick: () => go('overview') },
              { title: PAGES[page].title },
            ]}
          />
          <Spacer />
          <Button icon="search" onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}>
            Search <Kbd keys="mod+k" />
          </Button>
          <Dropdown
            trigger={['click']}
            placement="bottomRight"
            menu={{
              items: accountItems,
              onClick: onAccount,
              selectedKeys: [`mode:${colorMode}`, `density:${density}`],
            }}
          >
            <Button variant="text">
              <Avatar name={USER_NAME} size={24} />
              {USER_NAME}
            </Button>
          </Dropdown>
        </>
      }
      sidebar={<Nav items={NAV} value={page} onSelect={(key) => go(key as PageKey)} />}
    >
      {page === 'overview' && (
        <OverviewPage titleRef={titleRef} onOpenProjects={() => go('projects')} />
      )}
      {page === 'projects' && <ProjectsPage titleRef={titleRef} />}
      {page === 'settings' && <SettingsPage titleRef={titleRef} />}
      <CommandPalette
        open={searchOpen}
        onOpenChange={setSearchOpen}
        items={commands}
        placeholder="Search pages, projects and actions"
      />
    </AppShell>
  )
}
```
